an6.75:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaṃ viharati savighātaṃ saupāyāsaṃ sapariḷāhaṃ. kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā.
an6.75:1.3: kāmavitakkena, vyāpādavitakkena, vihiṃsāvitakkena, kāmasaññāya, vyāpādasaññāya, vihiṃsāsaññāya.
an6.75:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaṃ viharati savighātaṃ saupāyāsaṃ sapariḷāhaṃ. kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā duggati pāṭikkhā.
an6.75:2.1: chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu diṭṭheva dhamme sukhaṃ viharati avighātaṃ anupāyāsaṃ apariḷāhaṃ. kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugati pāṭikaṅkhā,
an6.75:2.3: nekkhammavitakkena, avyāpādavitakkena, avihiṃsāvitakkena, nekkhammasaññāya, avyāpādasaññāya, avihiṃsāsaññāya.
an6.75:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu diṭṭheva dhamme sukhaṃ viharati avighātaṃ anupāyāsaṃ apariḷāhaṃ. kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugati pāṭikaṅkhāti.
